title: Replication package for 'Goodness-of-Fit Indices and Diagnostics for Topic Models'
description: Code, cached results and data behind every table and figure of Goodness-of-Fit Indices and Diagnostics for Topic Models (Craig M. Lewis and Francesco Grossetti; submitted to the Journal of the Royal Statistical Society, Series B): the four simulation studies of Section 5, the MD&A empirical application of Section 6, and the September 2026 robustness arms. Three reproduction lanes: exhibits rebuilt from the shipped caches (minutes), full recompute (simulations about one day, MD&A about seven hours), and the robustness batch (about sixteen hours). The methods are implemented in the R package OpTop (https://github.com/contefranz/OpTop); install.R pins OpTop 0.20.0 and NLPstudio 1.2.0, and sessionInfo.txt records both production environments. The raw Item-7 corpus (178 MB) is deposited separately.
